verses.gurmukhi: ਮਜਨ ਕੈ ਚੀਰ ਚਾਰ ਅੰਜਨ ਤਮੋਲ ਰਸ ਅਭਰਨ ਸਿੰਗਾਰ ਸਾਜ ਸਿਹਜਾ ਬਿਛਾਈ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: majan kai cheer chaar a(n)jan tamol ras abharan si(n)gaar saaj sihajaa bichhaiee hai ||

en.bdb: Bathing myself clean, wearing beautiful clothes, putting collyrium in the eyes, eating a betel and adoring myself with various ornaments I have laid the bed of my Lord. (I have prepared myself for union with my beloved God Lord).

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੁਸਮ ਸੁਗੰਧਿ ਅਰੁ ਮੰਦਰ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਮਾਂਝ ਦੀਪਕ ਦਿਪਤ ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤ ਛਾਈ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: kusam suga(n)dh ar ma(n)dhar su(n)dhar maa(n)jh dheepak dhipat jagamag jot chhaiee hai ||

en.bdb: The beautiful bed is decorated with fragrant flowers and the beautiful room is lit up with radiant light.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋਧਤ ਸੋਧਤ ਸਉਨ ਲਗਨ ਮਨਾਇ ਮਨ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਬਿਧਾਨ ਚਿਰਕਾਰ ਬਾਰੀ ਆਈ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sodhat sodhat saun lagan manai man baa(n)chhat bidhaan chirakaar baaree aaiee hai ||

en.bdb: I have received this human birth after much effort for the union with the Lord God. (I have gone through many births to reach to this stage that is very auspicious).

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਉਸਰ ਅਭੀਚ ਨੀਚ ਨਿੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਮੈ ਸੋਵਤ ਖੋਏ ਨੈਨ ਉਘਰਤ ਅੰਤ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਈ ਹੈ ॥੬੫੮॥
verses.translit_en: aausar abheech neech ni(n)dhraa mai sovat khoe nain ugharat a(n)t paachhai pachhutaiee hai ||658||

en.bdb: But losing this opportunity of favourable constellation position for a union with God in the sleep of hateful ignorance, one will only repent when one wakes up (because by then it would be too late).  (658)
